verdict.rationale: Missive's developer docs list webhooks among its own developer tools, so the product itself offers the capability. The evidence is only a single one-line mention: nothing shows how to register a webhook, which events it fires on, or what the payload looks like. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration (UI or API), list of subscribable event types, payload/signature/retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Missive developer tools: REST API, UI integrations, webhooks, and custom channels for full customization.
